note.ja: 各行の最大非対角係数に対する相対強度からグラフを作り、貪欲な星型集約と余剰節点の隣接集約への付着で暫定補間Tを作ります。P=(I−ωD⁻¹A)T、ω=4/(3ρ̄)、ρ̄はD⁻¹Aの絶対行和上界です。粗演算子はPᵀAP。前後2回のJacobi平滑化と最終小行列の直接解を用います。これは採用した小規模SA変種であり、原著の全構築法や収束定理の再現ではありません。
note.en: A graph based on row-relative off-diagonal strength supplies greedy star aggregates; leftover nodes attach to adjacent aggregates. Smooth tentative T via P=(I−ωD⁻¹A)T with ω=4/(3ρ̄), where ρ̄ bounds the absolute row sums of D⁻¹A. Coarse operators are PᵀAP. V-cycles use two pre/post Jacobi sweeps and a terminal dense direct solve. This is a small adopted SA variant, not every construction or convergence theorem in the original paper.

note.ja: Householder反射を左から蓄積してRを上三角化し、Qを構成します。Jacobi SVDは列対の内積を小さくする直交回転を繰り返し、回転した列の長さを特異値とします。AᵀAを作って固有値を求める方法ではありません。最小二乗はQRの後退代入、階数落ちでは打切りSVDで求めます。
note.en: Householder reflectors triangularize R while accumulating Q. The SVD repeatedly rotates column pairs toward orthogonality and uses their resulting lengths as singular values; it does not diagonalize AᵀA. Least squares uses triangular back substitution for QR and truncated compact SVD for deficient rank.

note.ja: Lanczosの3項漸化式に2回の全再直交化を加え、Arnoldiは修正Gram–Schmidtを2回行います。小さな射影行列T/HだけをNumPyのeigh/eigで解き、元空間へRitzベクトルを戻します。大きな元行列の密固有値計算は参照側だけで使います。
note.en: Lanczos uses its three-term recurrence plus two passes of full reorthogonalization; Arnoldi uses two-pass modified Gram–Schmidt. Only the small projected T/H is solved by NumPy eigh/eig before lifting Ritz vectors. A full dense solve of the original matrix is used only on the reference side.

note.ja: Golub–Welschで対称Jacobi行列の固有値を節点、最初の固有ベクトル成分の平方の2倍を重みとします。適応Simpsonは区間を二分し、|S左+S右−S全|/15を局所推定として公差を配分します。評価回数と深さの上限を持ち、未達を成功としません。
note.en: Golub–Welsch obtains nodes from a symmetric Jacobi matrix and weights from twice the squared first eigenvector components. Adaptive Simpson bisects intervals and allocates tolerances using |Sleft+Sright−Swhole|/15 as a local estimate. Evaluation and depth limits report unmet targets explicitly.

name.ja: Householder QRと片側Jacobi SVD：直交性・階数・最小二乗：参照・比較条件
name.en: Householder QR and one-sided Jacobi SVD: orthogonality, rank and least squares — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 独立NumPy/SciPy参照、行列再構成・直交性・特異値・階数・最小二乗残差を確認します。PDEの参照解カードとは別の線形代数検証です。 別版では条件数、右辺摂動、数値階数の閾値を変え、残差と係数の前進誤差を分けます。LAPACKと実際の二進入力から作る高精度参照の役割を区別し、QR／SVD全般や任意の悪条件行列の保証にはしません。
note.en: Check independent NumPy/SciPy references, reconstruction, orthogonality, singular values, rank and least-squares residuals. This is linear-algebra validation rather than a PDE reference-solution card. A separate release varies conditioning, right-hand-side perturbations and numerical-rank thresholds while separating residual from coefficient forward error. Distinguish LAPACK from high-precision references built from actual binary input; no general QR/SVD or arbitrary ill-conditioned-matrix guarantee is implied.

name.ja: Lanczos・Arnoldi：Ritz値と固有対残差の収束：参照・比較条件
name.en: Lanczos and Arnoldi: convergence of Ritz values and eigenpair residuals — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 独立固有値参照と、各Ritz値・固有対の残差、直交性と反復収束を確認します。 別版では固有値間隔・非正規性・Krylov次元を分け、小さな残差と真の固有値誤差を区別します。近接固有値の部分空間比較を、個別ベクトルの精度や他の物理モデルの検証と同一視しません。
note.en: Check independent eigenvalue references together with Ritz/eigenpair residuals, orthogonality and iterative convergence. A separate release separates spectral spacing, nonnormality and Krylov dimension, distinguishing small residuals from true eigenvalue errors. A clustered-subspace comparison does not certify individual vectors or another physical model.

name.ja: Gauss–Legendreと適応求積：厳密次数・推定誤差・予算切れ：参照・比較条件
name.en: Gauss–Legendre and adaptive quadrature: exactness, error estimates and budgets — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 多項式モーメントの既知積分値と独立求積参照を使い、厳密性・推定誤差・評価回数制限を確認します。 別版では求積点数・許容誤差と相殺の感度を比較し、真の積分誤差と内部の推定誤差を区別します。狭い山を見逃す対照も診断対象であり、診断の合格は積分推定の成功と同じではありません。
note.en: Use known polynomial integrals and independent quadrature references to check exactness, estimated errors and evaluation budgets. A separate release compares rule order, tolerance and cancellation sensitivity while distinguishing true integration error from the internal estimate. A missed narrow bump is an intended diagnostic; passing that diagnostic does not mean the integral estimate succeeded.

name.ja: 行列から粗視化するAMG：残差と解誤差を分ける：参照・検証
name.en: Matrix-based AMG: distinguish residual and solution error — references and checks

note.ja: 正規化残差、SciPy spsolveとの相対解差、連続正弦解への離散L²型誤差、観測次数、operator complexityを保存します。節点順を無作為に置き換えた行列も直接解と照合し、幾何学的な粗格子を暗黙に使っていないことを確認します。反復予算0は未収束と報告します。
note.en: Store normalized residuals, relative solution differences against SciPy spsolve, discrete-L²-type continuum errors, observed order and operator complexity. A randomly permuted matrix is also checked against a direct solution to expose hidden geometric ordering assumptions. A zero cycle budget reports nonconvergence.

name.ja: Poisson／正弦波の製造解
name.en: Poisson / manufactured sine

note.ja: 製造解 両端はゼロDirichlet条件。目標解から外力を選ぶ製造解であり、任意の外力のPoisson解ではありません。 カードは1次元sin(πx)、こちらは2次元sin(πx)sin(πy)です。次元・右辺・FEMの誤差ノルムは異なります。
note.en: Manufactured solution Zero Dirichlet endpoints. The forcing is chosen from the target solution; this is not an arbitrary-source Poisson solution. The card is 1D sin(πx); this test is 2D sin(πx)sin(πy). Dimension, forcing and FEM error norms differ.

name.ja: Householder QRと片側Jacobi SVD：直交性・階数・最小二乗：参照・検証
name.en: Householder QR and one-sided Jacobi SVD: orthogonality, rank and least squares — references and checks

note.ja: QR/SVDの相対再構成誤差、Q/U/Vの直交性、SciPy LAPACK gesddの特異値、gelsd/gelsyの最小二乗解・階数、正規方程式の停留残差を比較します。特異ベクトルの符号は比較せず、零行列と予算切れも検査します。
note.en: Compare QR/SVD relative reconstruction, Q/U/V orthogonality, singular values from SciPy LAPACK gesdd, least-squares solutions/ranks from gelsd/gelsy and normal-equation stationarity residuals. Singular-vector signs are not compared; zero matrices and budget exhaustion are tested.

name.ja: Lanczos・Arnoldi：Ritz値と固有対残差の収束：参照・検証
name.en: Lanczos and Arnoldi: convergence of Ritz values and eigenpair residuals — references and checks

note.ja: ||Av−λv||₂、独立密行列固有値との差、基底の直交性を保存し、Krylov次元を増やした末尾の改善を確認します。非対称Ritz値の単調収束は仮定しません。恒等行列のhappy breakdown、零初期ベクトル拒否、次元予算不足も検査します。
note.en: Store ||Av−λv||₂, differences from independently solved dense eigenvalues and basis orthogonality; verify final improvement as Krylov dimension grows. Nonsymmetric Ritz convergence is not assumed monotone. Tests include identity-matrix happy breakdown, zero-start rejection and insufficient dimension budgets.

name.ja: Gauss–Legendreと適応求積：厳密次数・推定誤差・予算切れ：参照・検証
name.en: Gauss–Legendre and adaptive quadrature: exactness, error estimates and budgets — references and checks

note.ja: 全指定次数の多項式モーメント、SciPy roots_legendreの節点・重みとの差、解析exp積分の次数収束、解析atan積分とSciPy quadへの一致を測ります。公差を厳しくしたときの評価数と誤差を示し、5評価の強制予算切れ、非有限関数値も検査します。
note.en: Measure polynomial moments for every chosen order, node/weight differences from SciPy roots_legendre, order refinement for the analytic exponential integral, and agreement with analytic arctangent and SciPy quad references. Store evaluation counts/errors as tolerance tightens; test forced exhaustion after five evaluations and nonfinite integrands.

name.ja: Householder QRと片側Jacobi SVD：直交性・階数・最小二乗
name.en: Householder QR and one-sided Jacobi SVD: orthogonality, rank and least squares

note.ja: 実の縦長行列に対するHouseholder QRと片側Jacobi SVDを自作し、通常行列・列スケール差10⁶の行列・階数落ち行列を検査します。独立LAPACKの特異値と最小ノルム最小二乗解を照合します。
note.en: Original Householder QR and one-sided Jacobi SVD for real tall matrices are checked on ordinary, 10⁶-column-scaled and rank-deficient inputs, against separate LAPACK singular values and minimum-norm least-squares solutions.

name.ja: QR/SVD：既定特異値・摂動増幅・数値階数
name.en: QR/SVD: prescribed spectra, perturbation gain and numerical rank

note.ja: 二進で厳密に表現できる16×4行列の条件数を1から2³⁶まで変え、再構成誤差と解誤差を分けます。実際のbinary64入力に対し別環境で実行した80/120桁参照とLAPACKを比較します。
note.en: Vary condition number from 1 to 2³⁶ for exactly representable 16×4 dyadic matrices, separating reconstruction from forward solution error. Compare LAPACK and separately executed 80/120-digit references for the actual binary64 inputs.

name.ja: Lanczos・Arnoldi：Ritz値と固有対残差の収束
name.en: Lanczos and Arnoldi: convergence of Ritz values and eigenpair residuals

note.ja: 32・48次の対称／非対称行列でLanczosとArnoldiを自作し、Krylov次元4・8・16による最大実部の固有対の収束を測ります。行列全体を解く独立LAPACK参照と照合します。
note.en: Original Lanczos and Arnoldi on symmetric/nonsymmetric 32×32 and 48×48 matrices measure convergence of the largest-real-part eigenpair over Krylov dimensions 4, 8 and 16, against independent full-matrix LAPACK references.

name.ja: Krylov固有値：クラスター部分空間と非正規感度
name.en: Krylov eigenvalues: cluster subspaces and nonnormal sensitivity

note.ja: 48次のクラスター固有値と強い非正規上三角行列で、次元4/8/16/32のLanczos・Arnoldiを測ります。残差・前進誤差・固有値条件数・不変部分空間を分けます。
note.en: Measure Lanczos and Arnoldi with dimensions4/8/16/32 on 48-dimensional clustered symmetric and strongly nonnormal triangular matrices. Distinguish residual, forward error, eigenvalue condition number and invariant subspace.

name.ja: Gauss–Legendreと適応求積：厳密次数・推定誤差・予算切れ
name.en: Gauss–Legendre and adaptive quadrature: exactness, error estimates and budgets

note.ja: Legendreの3項漸化式からGauss節点と重みを構成し、2n−1次までの多項式モーメントと指数関数を検査します。適応Simpsonは指数関数とLorentz型ピークを積分し、解析積分・独立QUADPACKと比較します。
note.en: Construct Gaussian nodes/weights from the Legendre recurrence and test polynomial moments through degree 2n−1 and an exponential. Adaptive Simpson integrates exponential and Lorentzian peaks, against analytic integrals and independent QUADPACK.

name.ja: 求積：狭いピーク・相殺・端点・誤差推定の盲点
name.en: Quadrature: narrow peaks, cancellation, endpoints and estimator blind spots

note.ja: Gauss次数と適応公差を走査し、狭いLorentzピーク、平方根端点、巨大な相殺、零積分、見逃すcompact bumpを解析積分とQUADPACKで検証します。
note.en: Vary Gauss order and adaptive tolerance on narrow Lorentz peaks, a square-root endpoint, severe cancellation, a zero integral and a deliberately missed compact bump, using analytic integrals and QUADPACK.

name.ja: 行列から粗視化するAMG：残差と解誤差を分ける
name.en: Matrix-based AMG: distinguish residual and solution error

note.ja: 正方形Poisson問題から得たSPD行列だけを階層構築へ渡し、平滑化集約AMGのV-cycleを実行します。7²・15²・31²未知数で独立疎行列直接解、解析的な離散正弦モード、連続解への2次収束を分けて検査します。
note.en: Build a smoothed-aggregation hierarchy from an SPD matrix alone and run V-cycles. Problems with 7², 15² and 31² unknowns distinguish independent sparse direct solutions, analytic discrete sine modes and second-order convergence to the continuum solution.
